added.gloss: animal; living member of the animal kingdom
insect; six-legged arthropod in ordinary usage
energy; capacity to produce physical change
language; structured human/animal/artificial system of meaningful signs
intelligence; capacity to learn, reason, generalize and solve problems
system; organized arrangement of interacting parts
space; spatial extent, independent of location
maturity; being fully developed or adult
strike; impact; physical blow/contact with force
extinction of a species; the dying out of a kind of life
plot of a story; narrative line
surplus; quantity beyond what is needed
